history.title: Player history
history.loadError: Could not load history. Please try again.
history.syncError: Could not save changes. Please try again.
history.empty: There is no saved history for this player.
history.autoSyncHint: Your squad history is saved when you synchronize. Later observations reveal changes in skills and form.
history.firstOnly: This is the first observation. Changes will appear after a future synchronization with new data.
history.noChanges: No changes have been saved yet.
history.unchanged: No new changes in available data.

review.title: After the match
review.description: Compare predicted sectors with actual ratings. See where the model helps and where caution is needed.
review.error: Could not retrieve the match report. Refresh to try again.
review.emptyTitle: Save a plan before the match first
review.emptyHint: The report includes matches with a complete lineup and context saved before kickoff. The saved setup must match the setup that actually played.
review.holdoutHint: MAE is the mean absolute error — lower is better. The latest 20% of observations form a separate holdout. A small sample does not establish model accuracy.
review.replayHint: {{count}} comparisons replay a historical lineup using the current model. These were not forecasts saved before kickoff.
review.mixedVersions: This report contains different model versions. Aggregate results do not describe one version's accuracy.
review.exclusionHint: Missing data or a difference between the saved plan and the match prevents comparison. These matches do not improve or reduce the model's score.
review.noUpcoming: There are no forecasts saved for upcoming matches. Save a complete plan in match preparation.
review.legacyHint: This snapshot contains a lineup but no stored forecast ratings. Only a current-model replay will be possible.
